conclusion.statement: ARTIST stores routes in ProfileManager::mStoredData, passes that stored OptionsDataProfile to NotifyOtherModulesLoadComplete after a valid load, posts event 19 with one byte, and mirrors only the new-profile flag to GuiCache. The create-match UI reads route counts from a distinct live GuiCache OptionsDataProfile. No original stored-to-live route transfer owner is established by the traced callers.
conclusion.event19: One-byte completion event. Listener behavior is not exhaustively traced; the event payload contains no options-profile pointer or route arrays.
conclusion.runtimeLimit: Case B does not directly sample the live cache counters; the used=2 helpbar record and source gate are consistent with zero live counts, not a direct memory read.
